text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: saw a 30% p99 spike on staging after merging model_v2.2. Kernel routing started preferring fallback 'torch_xla' kernel on many small-batch requests; KV cache shows high eviction churn. Reverting onboarding stops the spike.
Devon Park: Oof. Any trace/profile?
Maria Chen: Here's a short profile dump from the fixture run:
```text
p99 latency: 230ms (baseline 170ms)
Top kernels by time: fallback_conv (42%), aten::embedding_bag (15%), kv_cache_eviction (9%)
KV cache metrics: evictions/sec = 1200 -> 520 after revert
``` 
Jon Liu: Which commits rolled in? tokenizer changed?
Maria Chen: Model tag: redwood/model-2.2.0-checkpoint. Tokenizer small change (BOS->CLS) but low risk. Suspect is the new kernel-selector heuristic that uses avg_seq_len to pick prefetch kernel; for bursty short sequences it chose the wrong kernel and triggered KV warmup churn.
Priya R: CC @SRE-Alex — this looks like a rollout blocker for Dedicated customers.
Infra-Bot: perf-ci/staging-p99 — regression detected: +28% (see https://dash.redwood/perf/2043)
SRE-Alex: Starting quick bisect: reverting the selector change (runtime commit abc123) locally and re-running the perf-grid.
Maria Chen: Bisect result: reverting abc123 drops p99 back to 168ms. Patch proposal: revert heuristic and implement selector to use 95th percentile of seq_len distribution rather than mean; also add a fallback avoidance threshold when kv_eviction_rate > 200/sec.
Devon Park: Immediate mitigation: force kernel pin for redwood/model-2.2.0 in shadow pools until fix lands. I'll open a canary config PR.
Jon Liu: Also recommend increasing KV cache initial TTL and enable prefix_cache for this model to reduce early evictions during warmup.
Maria Chen: Deploying canary now:
`/ops deploy shadow-model-2.2.0 --kernel=optimized_conv --prefetch=false`
deploy-bot: Canary deploy successful — shadow-model-2.2.0 on pool-staging-a (id: canary-9912)
Priya R: Thanks — monitoring for 30m, ping here with any regressions. :eyes:
SRE-Alex: 15m update: p99 trending back to baseline (172ms) and kv evictions dropped ~60%. Marking rollout-blocker as cleared for now, followup ticket assigned to runtime (RT-5432) for robust selector fix.
Maria Chen: Filed RT-5432 with perf traces and the bisect steps. Thanks team :pray:
